tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures match the archived spatiotemporal siphon-memory mechanism, but five rows are insufficient to identify its five parameters reliably. The fine trajectory batch supplies the needed dynamic observations.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter spatiotemporal siphon-memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not adequately identify its five coupled parameters; the archived mechanism specifies at least eight rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Static siphon or uncoupled transient models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot signatures indicate both sink-gradient dependence and coupled transient lag, so these mechanisms omit relevant behavior.
It does not resolve the coupled-dynamics identifiability ambiguity.
